summary: Kraft Heinz filed a Form 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing a segment reorganization effective in Q3 2026. The company merged West/East Emerging Markets and Asia Emerging Markets into one Emerging Markets segment, shifted certain European countries into Europe and Pacific Developed Markets, and now reports three segments: North America, Europe and Pacific Developed Markets, and Emerging Markets. Exhibit 99.1 supplies recast historical segment financials for fiscal 2023-2025 and interim periods. No transaction, security, or management event is present; previous financial statements are unaffected. This is a disclosure-only event with no special-situations angle.
